title: Staff drive a CyberUnicorn over Wi-Fi and install its firmware from the portal

source.ref: §8 Staff Wi-Fi remote and §9 Firmware updates. Build plan phases 4b and 6; owner 2026-10-20 in the project thread chose 'Yes, add it and apply it' for staff relay access.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. PREMISE RE-TESTED: private.relay_member_may_join had no staff branch, so Admin and Janitor could not join a device channel, and the portal had no way to install firmware (Daniel ran ./flash.sh in Terminal). Built: migration 20270346020000_relay_staff_join.sql (staff may join device:<id> for an active device whose relay is on; relay_manageable_devices untouched), applied to production on the owner's decision and the ledger version set to the file's. lib/devices/relay-store.ts listRelayDevicesForStaff and setRelayEnabledForStaff, lib/devices/relay-actions.ts listRelayDevicesForConsole and setConsoleRelay, lib/device/relay-transport.ts (RpcClient over Realtime broadcast, presence for online). Firmware: lib/devices/firmware.ts reads cu5k-v GitHub releases and checks manifest, size and sha256; staff-only GET /api/devices/firmware and /firmware/app (authz ledger, delegated); lib/device/flasher.ts writes app.bin at 0x10000 with esptool-js 0.7.0 loaded on demand. Portal: 'Wi-Fi remote' and 'Update firmware' features. No firmware release is published yet, so the updater shows 'No update yet' until a cu5k-v tag exists.

verify.note: Fails when the staff relay join migration or its staff branch goes, when a staff relay read or switch stops gating on platform staff, when the firmware reader or either firmware route goes or loses its gate, when esptool-js is imported statically, or when the portal stops opening the relay, switching it, reading the release or installing.
